title: Google’s Antigravity SDK adds offline local-agent workflows
friendlyTitle: Google adds agents that can work offline on your computer
summary: Google’s Antigravity SDK now supports local agent workflows, initially optimized for Gemma 4 26B A4B with LiteRT. It can also connect to OpenAI-compatible local servers such as Ollama, LM Studio and vLLM, while allowing hybrid cloud-and-device orchestration.
friendlySummary: The Antigravity SDK can now run AI-agent tasks with local models instead of sending everything to the cloud. It also supports mixed workflows where a cloud model plans and local models handle private files.
whyItMatters: Local agents can keep code and requests on the machine, avoid per-call API costs and continue offline. The trade-off is hardware: Google recommends more than 24 GB of VRAM or unified memory for the featured setup.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Local AI can improve privacy, reduce API costs and work without internet access. You will need a powerful enough computer.
